fieldNotes._location: Roster coords (28.004224,-82.017896) were wrong - that point is a US-98/Polk Pkwy interchange NE of Lakeland Linder Airport. The Publix Frozen Foods Warehouse (3300 Airport Rd, phone 863-688-1188) is part of the Publix Lakeland logistics complex WEST of the airport in the Drane Field / County Line corridor. The frozen DC is the refrigerated building cluster at ~28.007,-82.043, the ONLY sub-cluster in the area served by a full industrial ammonia refrigeration plant + tank farm (6+ horizontal ammonia tanks at 28.0050,-82.0428). It is distinct from roster idx1 'County Line' DC (28.014,-82.051, a separate large building 1.5km NW).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Whole DC sub-campus ringed by chain-link perimeter fencing (clear in Street View along the SW rural lane and z18/z19 sat). Trucks enter via fenced gate off the internal campus drive; no open public-road-to-dock driveway.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth resolved at the truck entrance in available Street View - SV does not penetrate the gated interior, and the public-road approach shows fence gates without a beside-lane booth. Set false but flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Inferred: gate present, no visible staffed shack implies kiosk/app/remote check-in. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved aprons and internal drives inside the fence give ample queue/holding room before the dock faces.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal entrance drive from the public lane to the dock faces easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Counted from z19 imagery: east building south face ~25-35 dock positions, north building south face ~15-20, plus the long west/big building dock bank. Total comfortably 50+. Estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large trailer drop yard NE of the east building (28.0082,-82.0407) packed with ~50-70 trailers in angled rows; counted from z19. 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage lot NE of the east DC, separate from the active dock aprons.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two-to-three distinct dock banks on different building faces (east bldg south face, north bldg south face, big west bldg NE face) suggest separate ship/receive clusters. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and generous internal paved width leave physical room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Three large warehouse buildings + a shared refrigeration plant form a multi-building campus.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town / rural setting: open fields, scattered single-family homes and low-traffic rural lanes immediately SW/S of the campus (Drane Field area S of Lakeland near the airport).
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Set false - although rural-edge, it is a major built-up logistics corridor with adjacent development, so cellular coverage is likely adequate.
fieldNotes.yardMetrics.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property in any imagery.
fieldNotes.yardMetrics.trailersVisible: Approx count of parked trailers across the drop yard and dock faces in captured imagery; estimate.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from the perimeter polygon (~52 acres) covering the frozen DC sub-cluster (3 buildings + refrigeration plant + drop yard).
